nom: Bioderma Sensibio Foaming Gel Face Cleanser for Sensitive Skin

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin repeatedly describe this cleanser as non-stripping and even hydrating, including one who calls it a fix for dry, watery skin after winter weather damage.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers identifying as sensitive report no irritation and gentle, non-drying cleansing, but two describe a reaction with rough red patches or a bad breakout on first use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive dry/combination skin reports the cleanser cleans thoroughly without needing an oil cleanser or feeling stripped.

concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone skin say the cleanser doesn't dry out their skin and one reports hormonal acne clearing up and another notes fewer breakouts after switching; however, three reviewers report new breakouts or small bumps across cheeks and chin after starting the product.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers, including those with dry skin, say the cleanser leaves skin clean without feeling dry, tight, or stripped, and some note it feels hydrating.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with highly sensitive skin reports rough red patches appearing after the first use, though most other sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation.

aspects.libelle: Struggles with waterproof or water-resistant products
Leaves skin feeling clean not tight

extraits.texte: I bought this product as I didn't see it had any pore cloggers or fragrances. I used it for about a week to give it a good test, and my skin looks terrible. I broke out all over my cheeks and chin with small bumps and my face looks dry

I have highly sensitive skin but read reviews and thought this would be a good cleanser to try. Unfortunately I had a reaction with the first use and had rough red patches across my face. I thought the cleanser was nice but it just didn't work for me.
I bought this for the third time. There are very few cleansers I can use due to my dry acne prone skin. It doesn't dry out my skin and is very gentle.

This is by far my favorite cleanser I've ever used. I have extremely sensitive dry/combination skin. I've been on the hunt for an inexpensive and basic cleanser that truly leaves my face clean. This is it! My skin hates oil cleansers, so my favorite thing about this is I don't need to double cleanse. My face feels so clean after using, yet it doesn't feel dry or stripped. This is the perfect basic cleanser and you get a ton of product so this bottle will probably last months. I occasionally get hormonal acne and this has helped clear it up. I have nothing negative to say about this cleanser. Definitely give it a try!

As someone with sensitive, dry, acne prone skin i have been searching for a good makeup remover. I tried all the oils, cleansing balms, miceller waters and this is by far my favorite!! It takes off my makeup well without stripping my skin or leaving it dry and tight. My skin always looks better after using this product.

extraits.titre: Tough on makeup, gentle on skin!
extraits.texte: I have very sensitive, dry skin and this micellar foaming cleanser is by far the best cleanser I have used! It great in removing makeup, leaving my skin feeling clean, yet doesn't dry it up like most other cleaners do. Love the micellar water as well! Such a dynamic duo!

As someone with very sensitive acne prone skin, this is the best cleanser ive ever used. Ive tried all the cleansing waters / balms / oils and this is definitely the one that best cleansing off any makeup or sunscreen that i may be wearing with aggressively stripping and drying my skin. This does not remove watter proof makeup but regardless is great and has helped my skin alot.
